svg.title: Automated Docker updates: Forgejo, Renovate and Komodo
svg.desc: A hand-drawn notebook page. Image registries publish a new version. The Renovate bot, running daily in Forgejo Actions, opens one pull request per stack. You review and merge it. A webhook makes Komodo run a Procedure that deploys the changed stacks to server-a and server-b. Critical stacks wait for your click on Deploy.
